team.name: BUZZ BOIL TAPS
taglines: we do random stuff we find interesting.
team.description: Three students. One oddly named team. Security research, CTFs, Hackathons, and whatever we decide to build next.
origin: It was our first CTF together. The organizers had a random name generator. They *rolled the dice*.
Out came *"Buzz Boil Taps"*. Completely meaningless and yet apparently this was our amazing branding now.
mission: We're *three students* from the same school, same class. We procrastinate homework to take apart code. We play CTFs, ship things at hackathons, dig for bugs, and build hardware that sometimes works on the first try (haha, i know, amazing joke there).

items: WHAT IF WE DID [INSERT INSANITY HERE]

members.name: Darsh Singhal
members.role: pwn / web exploitation / cloud exploitation / code guy
members.bio: You built it? I *break* it. You fixed it? *"You sure? :)"*. Other than that, I love python and can read (a tad bit) of assembly. I also like to build things and love AI stuff.

members.name: Ng Zheng Xian
members.role: web exploitation / pwn / CAD & PCB / spaghetti breadboard wiring guy
members.bio: You want a PCB? Sure! By tomorrow? You want a case and wired perfboard too? Uhhh bye. I love engineering, coding, IO! and cybersec but i have no time management skills. Please dont AI your PCBs.

members.name: Li Xinyuan
members.role: forensics / MA + RE / Insanity generator / math guy
members.bio: Give me a suspicious file and I'll probably open it before asking where it came from. Love forensics, MA, RE, and doing stupidly stupid things. Outside CTFs, I build web projects, get distracted by maths, and start more side projects than I can finish.

achievements.title: First Vulnerability Disclosure to [REDACTED] via SingCERT
achievements.description: We disclosed our first vulnerability to [REDACTED] via SingCERT! The vendor patched it upstream and we are currently working with them for disclosure / recognition. We are the first (at least ONE of the first) to disclose a vulnerability to them via SingCERT!

achievements.title: Intermediate Youth Cyber Exploration Programme CTF
achievements.description: Our first group CTF as well as exposure to a lot of skillsets for cybersecurity (fun fact this is where we got our name!)

achievements.title: NUSHHACK 25'
achievements.description: A really cool 24-hour hackathon! Also our very first time competing as three people on one team (wow we were babies back then)
